bars.says: A settler can distinguish dry pale stone and sand from black wet faces with gathered green and pools, including open seep oases, on the ordinary playable map.

meant.intent: The land must read as a dry country whose livable pockets follow condensation or seep water, with buildable dry shoulders; a generic green desert or a text-only weep fails.
meant.source: Frozen design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/weeping_stones.md §§1–6,9; selected experience in design/RimMandrake/biome_experiences_2026-10-20.md; delegated: spatial/building interpretation.

figurative.stands_for: Green clusters follow wet habitat rather than filling the whole map; not literal moving or social plants.
figurative.accept: Separated patches of native green trace a broken seep margin rather than forming a moving crowd.

accept: On the ridge a settler follows dark wet stone down to green at the pool; dry sand and a usable building shoulder remain outside it.
On a hot flat seep map a green pool stands in open rock and sand without a shaded cliff beside it; the water comes from below.
reject: The descriptions say wet rock, but the map is uniform sand with randomly scattered plants and an isolated blue puddle.
The map becomes continuous lush ground, or every flat seep pool is refused because there is no cliff.
bars.lazy: The descriptions say wet rock, but the map is uniform sand with randomly scattered plants and an isolated blue puddle.

range.varies: Fixed authored WeepingStones tiles: dew and hot seep regimes; flat/small/large/mountainous hilliness; authored Oasis landmark present/absent; sun elevations 0–90 degrees and bearings 0–359; all supported generated local-map sizes 150–400 cells per side, including shoreline/rock edge and built dry shoulders. Inspect fresh, used and reloaded maps. Numeric tile lore is historical, not a current population measurement.
range.left_out: No planet generation, tile reassignment or alternative planet seeds. No requirement for a pool on every cell or on every non-landmark tile; the authored landmark supplies its actual oasis.

bars.says: A colonist can forage and farm native food, find medicine and scarce timber, and meet living prey, grazers, predators and useful tame beasts, with the fictional flyers actually flying.

meant.intent: Ordinary native life supplies the settlement without needing a special event. Dewgourd takes patience and stores food; the existing cast remains useful and alien. A predator hunts the approaches, not full water.
meant.source: Frozen sheet and ruled flora/fauna rosters of 2026-09-24; dewgourd owner text in the flora roster; standing flight and native-water rulings; delegated: ordinary life grouped by use rather than def row.

figurative.stands_for: Native timber is present and gatherable, but collecting the scattered trees limits timber building and makes the settler choose what to build from wood.
figurative.accept: A settler gathers timber from separated native trees for a chosen wooden structure, then uses stone for further construction because the nearby timber has been used.

accept: A settler gathers bladder-fruit and salvecomb, tends dewgourds for later stores, cuts sparse native timber and raises a native pack animal while prey and a dewglider move around the oasis.
A native at its environmental water can satisfy its drinking need; the same place need not make an outsider heatproof.
Harvestable native trees stand apart across dry ground, and gathering them makes a wooden building possible while further wooden construction calls for another timber source.
reject: All the names resolve, but forage yields nothing useful, stock starves beside its own water, and the advertised dewglider only walks.
Dewgourd is harvested by a debug action while ordinary growth or storage never works.
The ordinary map has no harvestable native timber, so a settler can build with wood only after importing it.
Harvestable native trees cover the ordinary map as a continuous forest, so local timber never constrains the settler's building choices.
bars.lazy: All the names resolve, but forage yields nothing useful, stock starves beside its own water, and the advertised dewglider only walks.

range.varies: All current native flora and fauna by ordinary role, including juvenile/adult, wild/tame, hunger/thirst, birth/death and caravan use. Free roster and additive campaign roster; daylight/high heat and shade habitat; start, week, 15-day season and day 100 continuation. Dewgourd growth under the shared shipped growth engine; compare keeping produce in matched storage against ordinary perishable produce. Flight tracked in ground/takeoff/air/landing/cooldown states. Timber comparison covers ordinary authored oasis and non-landmark local maps before player cutting, after local cutting and after regrowth, across the declared map sizes and hilliness. Gatherability is read through normal harvest jobs and resulting usable timber.
range.left_out: No forced appearance of legendary gorrask on every map, no new species, no donor restoration, no roster evictions, no bespoke dances, vertical climbing, swarm pollination or extra product industry. No DLC-absent branch.

bars.says: A farmer can choose a water pen, stock and feed its breeders, take chosen surplus repeatedly, and preserve breeding stock without fresh wild captures replacing each harvest.

meant.intent: Fishing as gardening requires a renewable managed stock and meaningful player control, not automatic conversion of wild animals to meat. The positive route must exist under ordinary work priorities.
meant.source: Owner husbandry ruling 2026-09-24 in weeping_stones_stocked_pool_2026-09-24.md; selected experience 2026-10-20; delegated: minimal reserve, destination and chosen-harvest control needed to make husbandry real.

accept: A farmer stocks a selected pool, keeps food coming and takes surplus while breeders remain and later replenish the stock.
After the player deliberately overdraws a pen it goes quiet and needs restocking; the other tended pen continues producing.
reject: The job list says stock and feed, but workers immediately harvest all breeders and every later meal requires another wild capture.
Feeding only changes the inspect text while actual animals starve or leave the designated water.
bars.lazy: The job list says stock and feed, but workers immediately harvest all breeders and every later meal requires another wild capture.

range.varies: Every stockable species in compatible reproductive groups; murrin-only and mixed pens, newborn/adult/dead/downed residents; pen sizes 1,2,4,9,36,100 and 400 cells, populations empty/below reserve/at reserve/surplus/crowded; colonies 1,3,10,40; reachable/blocked banks and food; selected destinations; ordinary jobs in both feed-then-harvest and harvest-then-feed order; reload mid-carry and mid-cycle; 15-day season and day 100 continuation. Tiny/nonviable pens may refuse stocking with an actionable reason rather than pretending productivity.
range.left_out: No guarantee that a tiny farm feeds the whole colony, or that all species mixes are sustainable. The reserve is reproductively viable for the chosen species, not merely a body count; deliberate overdraw remains possible with a warning.

bars.says: A handler catches breeders when a thrown net covers them at landing, carries them into the chosen water pen, and sees the animal or its carried replacement after an interrupted job, with handling risk confined to the catch.

meant.intent: Speed and landing matter; animal-to-stock-to-animal conversion must be readable and conserved. Nasty catches have minor medical consequences, while feeding from the bank is safe from the handling roll.
meant.source: OWNER:1791380355976654559 in infrastructure/state/ledger/events/OWNER.jsonl; husbandry small injury decision in the 2026-09-24 stocked-pool sheet; standing no-unreadable-disappearance ruling; delegated transaction boundaries.

accept: A moving fish leaves the landing spread and the net misses; a covered fish is visibly entangled and becomes carried breeder stock when bagged.
The pen is removed during carry, so the breeder remains carried or is dropped with a readable reason; the handler and animal are still accounted for.
A biter catch leaves a readable cut while a bank feeding job does not inflict a catch injury.
reject: The handler freezes the animal before throwing, succeeds regardless of landing, or removes it while leaving no animal, carcass or breeder item.
A failed release or dead handler silently consumes the carried breeder, or multiple handlers duplicate it.
bars.lazy: The handler freezes the animal before throwing, succeeds regardless of landing, or removes it while leaving no animal, carcass or breeder item.

range.varies: All stockable species, stationary/walking/fleeing targets, takeoff/air/landing for actual flyers with owner-presence constraint; throw ranges 3–12, attempts 1–8 and obstructed LOS/map edge; two simultaneous handlers; interruption/death/downing/forbidden target at approach, windup, airborne net, bag, carry and release; output blocked/missing and reload at these transitions. Minor means no job-script maiming/death lottery, distinct from ordinary wound treatment risks.
range.left_out: No guaranteed capture rate, no mandatory successful fleeing capture, no new net equipment economy. A species described as jumping is not thereby a fictional sustained flyer; current skarrin flight is not assumed.

bars.says: A farmer looking at a pen can distinguish productive stock, developing hunger or crowding trouble, an empty pen and a vhorrin before choosing the next farm action.

meant.intent: The at-a-glance health gauge is necessary telemetry. Different dangerous states cannot all masquerade as healthy rings; inspect text explains a visible cue, not substitutes for it.
meant.source: Ruled stocked-pool sheet §3 READ; owner-selected experience 2026-10-20; delegated: pre-harm crowding warning and current post-change snapshot.

accept: The farmer sees thinning or a distinct crowding warning before avoidable loss, then the changed water display after feeding, harvesting or culling; inspect text gives the cause.
An empty pen has an identifiable empty-state marker, so absence of animation cannot be mistaken for an overlay that failed to load.
reject: The on-water picture never changes and only a selected zone inspect string says that stock is dying.
A fed crowded pen displays reassuring healthy rings until a vhorrin appears, or a culled pen still displays its old predator state.
bars.lazy: The on-water picture never changes and only a selected zone inspect string says that stock is dying.

range.varies: Population zero/reserve/surplus/crowded; fed/due/hungry; predator present/removed; murrin absent but other stock present; shallow/deep water, tiny/large/concave/adjacent pens, map-edge pens, clear/fog/sandstorm; pause/unpause; add/remove cells, feeding/harvest/cull and reload. Ordinary play zoom, selected and unselected pens, including colour-insensitive reading via shape/text cue. Cue timing must leave an ordinary scheduled response opportunity before the first avoidable farm loss; exact latency is calibrated in the season model.
range.left_out: No polished ring-animation catalogue, no per-species graphic-variant count, no natural oasis-drought alarm or required sound track.

bars.says: A neglected or crowded stocked pen shows trouble, can breed a vhorrin that consumes its stock, and can recover after a deliberate cull, while escaping fan eels leave a visible route to recapture.

meant.intent: The monster is the consequence of management and must actually damage the farm. Recovery is the return of viable stock, not a victory message alone. Escape must be movement the player can locate, not silent teleportation.
meant.source: Owner 2026-09-24 husbandry ruling and pool-state amendment; 2026-10-20 experience; delegated: explicit consumptive pressure, recovery and readable movement boundaries from the drafted stocked-line descriptions.

figurative.stands_for: A mismanaged stocked pool produces the vhorrin state from its stock; not literal mating between vhorrin parents or an ambient spawn.
figurative.accept: A stressed resident is visibly replaced by a vhorrin without any vhorrin parent or wild arrival.

accept: Crowding or missed feed changes the warning; a vhorrin emerges from the failing stock, remaining stock declines, and culling it lets a fed/restocked pen resume the ordinary farm loop.
A fan eel slips out along a visible traversable wet route, with an origin/destination cue, and is nettable outside; a blocked route leaves it in the pen.
A resident vhorrin takes pen stock, leaving a partly eaten carcass and a named pen cue while a predator hunt at that same protected water remains suppressed.
reject: A random wild vhorrin appears in a healthy tended pen or its presence never harms the stock; the cull only prints that the pool is saved.
An eel jumps invisibly through an intact wall, or a conversion deletes an animal with only a dev-mode log.
The pen census drops for vhorrin feeding with no remains or player cue, or stock loss requires disabling protected-water hunt suppression.
bars.lazy: A random wild vhorrin appears in a healthy tended pen or its presence never harms the stock; the cull only prints that the pool is saved.

range.varies: Fed/underfed/unfed and uncrowded/at threshold/overcrowded, all compatible stock mixes; no candidates/only vhorrin/candidates and vhorrin; same candidate selected for decay and conversion; empty, culled and restocked; escape paths open/blocked/other pen/map boundary; 1–40 colonists, 1–16 pens; reload before/after pulses, cull and recapture. Use forced random draws for branch coverage, real shipped random scheduling for incidence and time-to-response; season plus day 100 continuation. Resident feeding covers due/not-due feeding, reserved/unreserved victims, multiple vhorrins, no eligible stock, blocked remains placement, cull versus feeding order, and protected/unprotected pen water. A living non-vhorrin stock resident in the same pen is eligible regardless of species or breeder-reserve status, except while reserved by another transaction.
range.left_out: No fixed probability, compulsory monster in every bad pen during a short sample, off-pen disease spread, annual lockout, barrel event, terrain drying, ivvol immunity, new raid or collective cull job.

meant.intent: The output is a food choice with real vanilla mood consequences, not a raw-yield scoreboard or an ideology expansion. A cull supplies food for the recovery meal; ordinary fish is the clear comparison.
meant.source: Owner real doubt-meat card in weeping_stones_stocked_pool_2026-09-24.md head; OWNER husbandry text 2026-09-24; delegated: retain existing modest recipes and eater-specific thought route only.

The cull meat can become its recovery dish at an ordinary stove; a stored paste or gourd supports later meals without a special event.

Farm catch only becomes usable through an extra mod, or the feast rewards the whole colony despite nobody eating it.

bars.says: At full oasis water predators abandon hunts and a guilty attack brings the water wildlife against the aggressor faction, while ordinary farm care does not turn the gathering against its handler.

meant.intent: The complete water gathering and owner-chosen guilt-based retribution are required life constraints; this does not add neutral-zone raid diplomacy or replace the shared engine's guilt test. Vhorrin feeding is a designated pen-stock conversion under R14. It leaves remains and a cue within the protected water, and grants no predator a hunt exemption.
meant.source: Frozen sheet §§4–6; 2026-09-24 truce acceptance, tame-predator side effect included; shine portfolio verdict 5; EnvironmentalHazards shared implementation; delegated: test farm jobs against the same law.

accept: A hungry wild or tame predator abandons a chase as either animal enters protected water; a margin predator outside it can still hunt.
A guilty raider hit at the pool rouses nearby eligible wildlife against that faction; an engine-classified self-defense hit does not newly blame the defender.
A handler feeds, nets, harvests and culls designated farm stock without retaliation caused by their ordinary farm-care job.
reject: Animals stand peacefully only because hunger or AI was locked off; the truce ends when the fixture unlocks.
Any damage makes every map animal manhunt indiscriminately, or a farm handling scratch incriminates the handler and rouses the pen.
bars.lazy: Animals stand peacefully only because hunger or AI was locked off; the truce ends when the fixture unlocks.

range.varies: Victim, predator and wildlife positions inside/on/outside the shared water-radius boundary; wet/dry/removed/restored water cells, shallow/deep and adjacent pens; hungry wild/tame predators; neutral/player/raider faction instigators, guilty/non-guilty, zero/positive damage, downed/dead/in-mental-state wildlife, turrets/projectiles/melee, repeated hits across cooldown and reload. Also normal bank feeding, thrown net, harvest, cull, injury callbacks and escape during retaliation. Every authored full-water regime; physical water source, not stock health, defines full water. Include a due vhorrin stock-feeding conversion at protected pen water while hungry wild/tame predator hunts remain suppressed, followed by a guilty player weapon-hit control.
range.left_out: No new truce-engine semantics, moral reconstruction of who started a whole battle, promise of retaliation when no eligible wildlife exists, guaranteed raid victory, diplomatic reputation system or dying-natural-pool scarcity scuffle. Designated farm conversion is not an exemption for ordinary player weapon attacks.

qualification.reject: Delegated rejection inference from the cited intent: losing this experience defeats the defined first version even if other bars hold.
qualification.renormalize: No particular yield, odds, time, art-variant count or stat is required; preserve the described player comparison.
qualification.first_version: needed by life: frozen full-water gathering

bars.says: Across a season on a full map the colony lives among dry stone and wet native gatherings, repeatedly farms food, reads and remedies a troubled pen, and resumes after saving without runaway stock, bare habitat, stalled work or repeated errors.

meant.intent: Exactly the complete first version, with its normal colony actions and shared engines running together; observations must separate a viable farm from a flood of animals, stripped desert, stuck jobs or log storm.
meant.source: User cleansing brief whole-bar requirement; owner experience 2026-10-20; delegated: integrated seasonal picture and failure categories.

accept: Ordinary work feeds the tended pens and produces repeat meals, while an intentionally neglected pen warns, fails and recovers; the oasis margins remain alive and dry building ground remains available after the mid-season reload.
Changing the order of feed, surplus harvest, cull and restock produces the expected temporary differences and still returns viable pens to production without resetting their history.
reject: The display looks healthy only while weather, breeding, truce or work givers are disabled; unlocking the complete map empties the pens or fills the map with stock and job errors.
Saving forgets the hungry pen or repeats a completed capture, then the colony stalls or receives endless warnings after reload.
bars.lazy: The display looks healthy only while weather, breeding, truce or work givers are disabled; unlocking the complete map empties the pens or fills the map with stock and job errors.

range.varies: 15 consecutive in-game days on each of the dew-shade and hot-flat-seep full-map regimes, with 3 and 40 colonists and map sizes 250 and 400 (plus B1/B3 generator coverage for intervening supported sizes); ordinary seasonal transition, production, ordinary weather, growth, hunger, breeding, predation, truce, cooking and caravans. Include a save at the middle, reload and continue from it; rerun main actions in the other order (feed/harvest and cull/restock). Also continue the worst stressed schedule to day 100 for runaway/stall risk. Compression may speed wall-clock ticks only; preserve actual game ticks, job competition, RNG ordering, needs, births, growth, weather decisions, save serialization and stock-pulse cadence.
range.left_out: No claim that arbitrary deliberate total starvation, fully walled banks or unsupported cross-biome switches remain productive; those must fail readably through the specific bars. No next-version extras, world painting, alternative planets or custom-quest spectacle.

sees.instrument: Real full-map run with time-series state/log reads, ordinary work observation and live map views; Whole-map husbandry season supplies calibrated worst-case schedules, not a claim that a simulation measured the game (T20).
sees.start: Fresh existing-world local-map fixture and ordinary colony with known initial food/stock, viable breeder reserve, accessible banks and both tended/control pens. Record full deployed build/settings/engine fingerprint. All mechanics unlocked. No forced births, mature-crop staging or debug stock replacement after founding.
sees.on: All kept land, native life, ordinary fishing, stocked pools, health display, handling, emergence/cull, escape/recapture, cuisine thoughts, shared truce suppression/retribution, shared Direct Sun and growth are ON at shipped defaults; no weather/time/AI locks; all DLC and composed mandrake.rm.biomes. Next-version extras OFF. Free and campaign-added roster contexts where relevant.
sees.control: Keep full activation and lock-state snapshots at start, reload and end; log all births/deaths/captures/food/job outcomes. Matched deliberately neglected pen must differ from tended pen, and the second action order must execute rather than replay a prepared result. Absence of custom scripts alone is not a clean-log observation. If ordinary stressed pens show no emergence in this interval, report the missing causal observation and continue the declared stress schedule or use another existing-world disposable fixture; do not force a roll or claim a debug monster demonstrates the ordinary cycle.
sees.reset: Use disposable fixtures on the existing authored world; keep a pre-scene save plus settings, terrain, zones, pawn/item identities, weather/time-lock and log-cursor journal. Reload that fixture, restore captured settings at their declared scope, verify the before-state digest and delete only test-created fixtures. Never use the canonical world save or the current destructive suite teardown as restoration.
sees.live_only_why: A pure seasonal stock model omits the live AI scheduler, needs, pathing, terrain presentation and mod callback order whose coupling is the open risk. Only a complete running-map observation can certify this integrated experience.

qualification.reject: Delegated rejection inference from the cited intent: losing this experience defeats the defined first version even if other bars hold.
qualification.renormalize: No particular yield, odds, time, art-variant count or stat is required; preserve the described player comparison.

checks.what: Parse source and post-patch runtime lists as named XML children; animalDensity/plantDensity positive, generatesNaturally=false, all DLC present, no new world-generation hook. Record source/deployed/settings fingerprints; loaded cache is authoritative for this fixture.

Existing numerical PoolKernel snapshot: pulse 2500 ticks, thin fraction 0.5, thin at 2 unfed days, decay at 3, decay chance 0.03, crowded emergence 0.02/crashed 0.01, configured multiplier 1, escape chance 0.05. These are baseline regressions, freely retunable, never passing criteria.

Snapshot and roundtrip all current/proposed switch values with actual effects. Existing net sliders range 3–12 cells and 1–8 attempts, vhorrin odds 0–3, escape 0–0.25; clamp corrupt/NaN/out-of-range persisted data. Extra defaults and all-off effects, not UI field presence, are asserted.

Resolve race/kind, meat/catch/breeder conventions for stockable species, declared recipes and actual stove wiring. No ambient vhorrin row. Known-absent probe must fail. Keep old script floors as revisable inventory checks, never experience bars.

Conservation table per transaction: live+carried+stored animal equivalents, carcass/meat outputs, reason and input/output identity map. Feed timestamp only advances on committed delivery; scribed pen identity/reserve/feed debt survives load and cell changes.

Record current post-mutation gauge versus census for empty/thin/healthy/crowded/vhorrin cases and all feed/cull/edit transitions. Signal delay/response timing belongs in model output, not a pinned bar latency.

Current dewgourd baseline from defs: growDays 26, fruit yield 7, nutrition 0.5 each, rot-start 60 days; verify through shared growth rather than treating growDays as actual calendar duration. Comparison to ordinary produce establishes keeping value.

Actual flight tracker states for dewglider/mirrik and any campaign flyer touched; current skarrin has no flight stat, so legacy fleeing-flier test label is not evidence. No unattended flyer visual test.

Retain water-field membership, actual guilty flag, victim cell, eligible wildlife and resulting target faction; outside-field, zero-damage and non-guilty negative controls. Capture cooldown and reload behaviour without assuming custom moral attribution.

Ingestion matrix: loomu/huldu/ivvol direct and ingredient memories, ordinary fish absence, Psychopath/Bloodlust exceptions, recipe products, rot ticking, and existing feast/broth memories on actual eaters only.

Source/read dependency checks: Mirrik spawn route is missing from current inline biome block; dewshrooms are currently TheRot-shared despite duplicate/diverge ruling. Reconcile loaded spawn/plant mappings without evicting species. Record additive campaign multi-home rows and source provenance.

Extra-off state census on fresh default map and after reload: no special old gorrask, mobile pool edits, choice/quest letters, quest offers/raids, condenser water, cocoons/fabric production, huldu-fat recipe/products, special rare loot or local found-tech study effects. Positive enabled controls prove gates are real; do not globally disable a neighbour to fake absence.

Whole-run floor: successful load, missing-reference/exception-free log delta, actual settings screen and persistence. A red check is diagnosed as code/check/fixture fault, never automatically an additional refusal bar.

rules.rule: Existing authored world only; an Oasis landmark supplies its required mutator. Local map content creation is allowed; no worldgen/painting, no alternative planets, no tile-count finding. Non-landmark dry shoulders need not grow a new oasis.

Direct Sun is the standing shared geometric rule. Roofs and parasols cover; air temperature is vanilla. Remove local heatKind/offset assumptions and false roof/sun-shield advice; do not design a second sun model.

A pen is a player-named contiguous orthogonally connected set of water cells with a persistent identity. Separate zones, even in connected water, are separate management units. Refuse disconnected additions rather than invent automatic split/merge identities. Dry/bridged-over cells become ineligible; preserve feed debt and reservations on surviving identity and show why it shrank. Deleting a zone releases living residents, never kills them or silently resets another pen.

Feed is ordinary suitable nutrition delivered from a reachable safe bank, explicitly permitted by player food policy. Delivery must satisfy actual stock needs as well as the feed clock; no credit before delivery. Invalid destination preserves or visibly drops carried food. No new scrap item/wind-income/water-budget system. Food quantity can be retuned.

Provide selected destination, reproductively viable breeder reserve and a deliberate surplus-harvest request per pen. Default automation feeds and maintains but never liquidates breeders; overdraw requires an explicit warning/choice. Cull is deliberate and is not a blanket auto-kill job. Ordinary stock reproduction is required, not a spawn replacement disguised as a birth.

Use the shared EnvironmentalHazards field and DamageInfo.InstigatorGuilty unchanged. Hunger and chase suppression share its radius. Direct player weapon violence remains guilty when the engine says so, including at a farm. Animal handling injuries and deliberate farm conversion must not manufacture a guilty player damage hit; if the real engine contradicts this, raise the measured conflict rather than adding a private truce exemption.

Conversions are atomic with readable outcomes: prepare/validate output before removing the input, preserve identity or an explicitly mapped replacement, serialize in-progress ownership, and account for failures/dead handlers. Kill/carcass, netted stock, meat/cull, visible escape, warned emergence and consumed by vhorrin (remains plus cue) are readable reasons; a dev-only log is not. Never duplicate animals or items after reload.

Render current post-mutation pen census and feed/crowding cause; no healthy cue for a crowded or due-danger pen. Thin, empty and vhorrin cues need shape/inspect explanations. Apply grace only to genuinely new pens, not every reload or cell edit. A warning must allow an ordinary care job before avoidable loss.

Shipped default: stocked pools, native flora, required warnings and shared life protection ON; all listed next-version extras OFF and labelled Next version. Major switches stop their real effects, not just UI. Immediate job stop is safe at a transaction boundary; startup/map-only options say so. No new cross-biome switch. Keep defs/code/load compatibility for deferred systems and do not silently delete legacy unique animals on disable.

Try normal verified vanilla animal mating/needs and existing shared growth before any replacement engine. Record actual integration; a neutral released pawn is not proven to breed by XML alone. Use shipped shared engines, including soaking from other active content, without locally creating rain or redesigning them.

Use existing vanilla recipes/ingredient memories for ordinary fish and doubtful beasts, with direct/ingredient and trait distinctions. Keep ordinary diet/ingredient access through both stoves. No global meal-quality C# or colony-wide feast event. Bone/leather from normal butchery is a separate vanilla path, never duplicated by direct pen harvest.

Fan-eel escape is an individual visible traversal along a connected traversable moist bank/water route to reachable open ground/water; reject through-wall or map-exit teleport. Respect the same farm identity/capture conservation. Uncrowded eels can escape as already coded; crowding is an additional farm risk, not an unsupported guarantee that causes every escape.

Keep every admitted animal placement, including multi-homed species, and the explicitly kept reeds art. Lore scale is not multi-cell collision geometry. Invented natives remain RM tier; campaign creatures enter additively by Utinni patches. Standing art acceptance is not reopened; actual absence/misrender or false behaviour advice still requires correction.

Vhorrin feeding is a pen-stock bookkeeping conversion on the existing pool pulse. Each resident vhorrin has a saved next-feeding deadline with a retunable interval. Start it after the emergence warning permits ordinary care or culling. This deadline advances on game ticks even at protected water, independently of hunger suppression or ordinary feed deliveries. When due, select a living non-vhorrin resident uniformly from the same current pen, excluding animals reserved by another transaction. Breeder reserves do not protect stock from this failure consequence. Revalidate the eater, victim, pen and uncommitted identities at commit. Convert the victim atomically into a partly eaten carcass at its cell, deduct the consumed portion from recoverable food, and show an ordinary pen cue naming the vhorrin and victim. Set the next deadline from the current commit time and commit it with the loss and remains, with no separate meat/loot payout. Failed remains placement or no eligible victim preserves stock and the pending deadline. Cull before commit cancels feeding. Serialize this ownership and deadline so a reload cannot repeat consumption. This uses the farm conversion path and grants no predator hunt exemption, changes no truce radius or guilty-bit rule, and targets no wild animal, other pen, drinker outside the stock census or colonist. Validate actual callbacks against the shared engine before believing compatibility.

meetings.why: Wild spawn pressure, real drinking/feeding/mating, truce suppression and penned stock are coupled; full water could sustain an animal flood or starve the margins.
Clock credit versus real needs and staffing competition can create a healthy display while stock dies; body count/pen area cannot alone price feed.

Meal thoughts attach to actual ingestion and its ingredient record, using ordinary trait filters. Farm production changes available food, not the identity of its eater; no global feast memory can feed back into food production.

Ordinary Oasis and biome XML do not establish wet faces, playable dry shoulders or spatial native growth. Shared shade, map dress, herds and penned water may interact; the whole-map land read is unmeasured.

All users read the committed current census plus feeding/crowding causes. A single snapshot and pending-transaction exclusion prevents simultaneous healthy/danger views; the live glance test still judges readability. This is a design consistency argument, not evidence the current renderer exists. A committed vhorrin feeding updates this same census and identifies the victim in its ordinary cue, with remains as independent loss evidence.

Net/release/harvest/cull, handlers dying, truce damage callbacks and multiple workers meet at the same conversion boundary; branch/conservation walk is needed. Due vhorrin feeding competes with cull, decay, emergence, capture and harvest for the same identities and remains placement.
Landing coverage, moving targets, walls, escape routes and map bounds must agree through interruption, not only inside a launch-time radius.

The only kept interfaces are load-safe defs and optional read-only scanner targets; no kept farm job calls the moving condenser, dewsilk, fat, rare loot or study hook. Gating at each production/offer callback breaks their cycles without redesigning shared engines.
Zone identity, terrain eligibility, targeted carries and escape routes can disagree during edits/reload; enumerate the transition region rather than judging a rectangle.

Save between input removal/output placement, pulse mutation and pen edit may replay or lose state; enumerate legal save boundaries and compare with uninterrupted execution. Include the saved vhorrin feeding deadline, victim ownership and committed remains/cue so loading cannot replay a meal.
Shared accelerated/soaked growth, foraging, herbivores and native habitat may strip the map or cover it. No isolated mature-plant harvest answers this.

Every food/item path has an explicit consumed input and a separate output role; no fat-quality loop, free repeat breeder conversion or duplicate bone/leather claim remains in scope. The stock model measures economics; the transaction model measures conservation. Vhorrin consumption deducts its eaten portion and leaves accounted remains without a separate meat or loot payout.

Default-off extras have no role in any kept cause/effect. Within kept mechanics a feature switch has an explicit stop boundary; arbitrary optional off configurations are graceful degradation checks, not counterexamples to a default-on bar.
Birth, hunger, unrestricted current harvest, vhorrin loss, escape and reserve are a feedback loop; a viable season cannot be inferred from pairwise job proofs.

All consumers use the same shared geometry and vanilla ambient temperature. A wet face does not grant heat immunity and a hot seep need not have shade; changing a biome cannot select a different sun rule.

B6 requires vhorrin stock consumption at protected pen water, while B8 and R6 suppress predator hunts there. R14 supplies a designated same-pen conversion with remains and a named cue, under R7 conservation, without a hunt exemption. Shared callbacks, victim-position attribution, emergence/cull and concurrent edits must still be calibrated against real traces to establish that resident feeding coexists with suppressed hunts and guilty-hit retaliation.
